Pawmi

Electric

Paldea · Generation 9

Pawmi is an Electric-type Mouse Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 2.5 kg. It evolves into Pawmo. Its highest base stat is Speed (60), with a base stat total of 240.
